robot_tag.mount: top plate centre, tag +x perpendicular to leg 0

floor.floor_foot_source: solved from the overhead camera's fix of the belly-down robot (P + (T-P)/k, k=55/610); frame bottom-centre maps to (-461, 842)
floor.parallax: true ground point = apparent - k*(apparent - foot), k = plate_height/camera_height
floor.view: across the grid from the -y side; sees all rows; robot plate tag unreadable beyond x~+300 mm and when body pitch > ~10 deg

overhead.view: top-down on the arena centre; sees 104/105/106/111/112/118 and the robot when within ~0.6 m of centre

arena_mm.notes: x1 500: hexapod-1 parks at x~600; y1 430: the floor camera stands at y~860 and the robot walked under it twice

heading_offsets_deg.meaning: world angle of the RL policy's body +x / +y velocity axes = tag-119 heading + offset (calibrated 2026-09-11 with a +vx / +vy probe of the allheading policy)

110.method: floor-camera homography from the 7 surveyed anchors, grid-snapped (110/111/106/118 within 11-19 mm of a grid site); 107 was a robot body tag and is excluded

111.method: floor-camera homography from the 7 surveyed anchors, grid-snapped (110/111/106/118 within 11-19 mm of a grid site); 107 was a robot body tag and is excluded

106.method: floor-camera homography from the 7 surveyed anchors, grid-snapped (110/111/106/118 within 11-19 mm of a grid site); 107 was a robot body tag and is excluded

118.method: floor-camera homography from the 7 surveyed anchors, grid-snapped (110/111/106/118 within 11-19 mm of a grid site); 107 was a robot body tag and is excluded

localiser_rules: fixes need >=5 mapped tags (4 only with rms < 6 mm) spanning >=2 grid rows; single-row sets are collinear and put the robot metres away
one camera per guarded run; the two cameras' fixes differed by 0.1-0.3 m at view edges without intrinsics
rms limits: floor camera 40 mm, overhead 60 mm
source: tmp/walk_session/{loc.py,floorkeeper.py} session 2026-09-11; see rl_docs/RISE_FALL_HEXAPOD2_2026-09-11.md and Robot Lab hexapod2 runs of that day
